summary: The competitive landscape is dominated by 100% Sidecar carousel posts utilizing automated DM-funnels ('Comment LINK/SHOP') to drive massive comment volume, ranging from an average of 2,780 to 11,605 comments per post. In stark contrast, the creator (@trendstrykarle) currently has a tiny footprint with only 1 post yielding just 61 likes and 2 comments, completely missing out on the carousel-plus-automation growth loop.
topPerformerInsights: Competitors exclusively post multi-image Sidecar carousels showcasing curated apparel collections, seasonal trends, and specific items (e.g., denim, linen pants, hoodies).
Every single top-performing competitor post deploys a strict gating CTA—instructing users to follow the account and comment 'LINK' or 'SHOP' to receive automated product links in their DMs.
Accounts like @manly.looks achieve massive scale (averaging 196K likes and 11,605 comments) by pairing high-intent niche menswear content with friction-free comment triggers.
Competitors hide like counts on a majority of their posts to focus audience attention entirely on saving the carousel and triggering the comment funnel.
ownAccountGaps: The creator has only published 1 total post ('5 SHIRT COLORS EVERY MAN SHOULD OWN') compared to 30 active posts across all competitor accounts.
The creator's single post received a meager 61 likes and 2 comments because it completely omitted the high-converting 'Comment LINK' automated CTA used by all competitors.
While the creator's educational listicle format (5 shirt colors) is strong, it lacks the multi-slide visual product showcase (Sidecar format) that compels users to stop scrolling and engage.
The creator's caption cuts off mid-sentence and fails to drive algorithmic behavior or monetization via affiliate/shopping DM automation.
recommendations: Immediately pivot the content format to 100% Sidecar carousels featuring curated outfit grids, lookbooks, and shoppable men's essentials.
Implement an automated DM tool (like ManyChat) paired with a rigid caption CTA on every post: 'Follow & Comment LINK to get links 🖇️'.
Add explicit follow-gating to captions (e.g., 'Follow karoge tabhi link aayega') to systematically convert commenters into permanent followers, mirroring @_esthetic.whispers' strategy.
Scale posting frequency from 1 lifetime post to a consistent volume of 4-5 Sidecar carousels per week targeting high-intent men's fashion niches (denim, shirts, linen pants).
Hide like counts on future carousel posts to reduce social proof anxiety and artificially concentrate user actions onto comments and saves.
